Autofill Agreement

Look up Agreement ID (Ops Internal) from the live Assets table in Master Folder_250923.xlsx, fill the embedded PDF template, save to SharePoint, or download.

Excel source: ready after sign-in

Paste a table copied from Excel or Google Sheets. The first row must contain the preset headers. Each following row becomes one agreement item that can be reviewed, previewed, saved to SharePoint, or downloaded separately.

Open the template in Excel, fill one agreement per row, then copy the completed table and paste it below.
Preset table format
The template contains only fields that are filled into the agreement form. Each row represents one agreement. You may leave any field blank and edit it during review.
Tab-separated tables copied directly from Excel are recommended. CSV is also supported.
Imported agreement items
Search for an Agreement ID, review the fields, then generate the PDF preview.
